subject: CloudScale pricing bands & add-route recap
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2027 15:09:00 -0700
Subject: CloudScale pricing bands & add-route recap

Hi Elena — great talking earlier. Quick recap from my side and a few clarifying asks so we can put a clean proposal on paper: 

Notes from the call:
- You currently run ~22M tokens/month (mainly chat & a small set of embeddings).
- Target is to consolidate additional routes: ingest pipeline + realtime chat (~additional 40M) and batch analytics embeddings (~60M) over the next 6 months.
- Primary constraint: keep unit cost predictable for finance while maintaining low tail latency for customer-facing routes.

Clarifying asks for the proposal (please confirm):
1) Expected steady-state monthly token mix (approx): chat gen 60%, embeddings 30%, misc rerank 10%?
2) Target blended budget range for the first 1M tokens metric (your target $/1M tokens) — you mentioned mid-$70s to low-$90s range on the call; can you confirm a target figure or a hard budget cap?
3) Is a 3-tier volume band model acceptable (0-50M / 50-200M / 200M+), or do you prefer custom pricing by route/model?

Next steps I propose: I’ll draft a blended-rate proposal that shows: a) per-route unit prices, b) blended $/1M token outcomes at the 50M and 120M milestones, and c) an optional reserved capacity add-on for the realtime route. I’ll attach a preliminary pricing spreadsheet and SOW for review.

Deliverable timeline: I can send the draft by Tue 16 Mar. If that works, confirm the numbers above and I’ll lock it in.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx (pricing bands + blended math), CSL_SOW_draft.docx (scope + timelines)

From: Elena Park <elena@cloudscale.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Cc: CloudScale Labs Procurement <procurement@cloudscale.com>
Date: Sat, 13 Mar 2027 09:17:00 -0400
Subject: Re: CloudScale pricing bands & add-route recap

Thanks Diego — clear recap. Quick answers inline: 

1) Mix: yes — updated expected steady-state mix: chat gen 55%, embeddings 35%, analytics/rerank 10%. We expect chat to grow faster once we flip traffic (so those percentages are directional).
2) Budget target: we’re looking for ~ $80 / 1M tokens as a target for blended cost. Procurement can stretch to $95 / 1M if rate cards show clear latency guarantees or reserved capacity.
3) Volume bands: 0-50M, 50-150M, 150M+ would be better aligned to our product road map.

A couple of extra items for the SOW:
- Can you call out model variants (standard gen vs high-throughput quantized) per route and the expected latency SLOs?
- Any initial on-boarding credits or one-time migration discounts that could help us bridge first 2 months of higher spend while switching routes?

Procurement is looped on budget. We’ll likely need a short version of the pricing for our internal TCO template as well.

Cheers,
Elena Park
Head of Platform Engineering, CloudScale Labs
elena@cloudscale.com

-----Original Message-----
On Fri, Mar 12, 2027 at 3:09 PM Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena — great talking earlier. Quick recap from my side...

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Preliminary blended pricing + route breakdown (attached)

Elena — thanks for the quick clarifications. Attached is a preliminary sheet (CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx) and a short SOW draft that maps routes to model tiers. High level summary below: 

Assumptions used: steady-state mix at 55/35/10 (chat/emb/analytics), growth to ~130M tokens/mo over 6 months.

Proposed unit pricing (USD per 1M tokens) by bucket: 
- Chat (realtime; low-latency tier, reserved option): $120 / 1M tokens (reserve) or $140 / 1M on-demand
- Embeddings (batch quantized): $50 / 1M tokens
- Analytics / rerank (high-throughput quantized): $40 / 1M tokens

Volume bands (blended examples):
- 0-50M: blended ~$105 / 1M
- 50-150M: blended ~$82 / 1M
- 150M+: blended ~$68 / 1M

Notes: These numbers include suggested caching and batching settings we discussed, plus a modest onboarding credit applied to month 1 spend (see sheet). If you target $80 / 1M blended, the 50-150M band hits that — we can align contract bands to guarantee the blended outcome at the 120M milestone.

Next items for me: 
1) If procurement confirms a target blended cap (you mentioned $80-$95), I’ll prepare two contract options: A (blended cap guarantee with reserved lane for chat) and B (strict per-route rate card with usage true-up).
2) Can you confirm whether legal prefers SOW + PO (we start work on acceptance) or DocuSign signature for the MSA + SOW?

Attaching the files — I’ll follow up with a short internal note to Marissa/Ben on discounting if we need to tighten the blended cap.

Best,
Diego

Attachments: CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx, CSL_SOW_draft.docx

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: CloudScale target $80 blended — discount ask

Marissa / Ben — quick internal: CloudScale is asking for a target blended cap of $80 / 1M at ~120M tokens. My preliminary sheet (attached) hits ~$82 blended at 130M with the rates I proposed. They called out that if we can commit a reserved lane for chat (small commit) and a 2-month onboarding credit, finance will accept $80.

Two options I see: 
A) Approve small commercial concession: 5% off chat reserve rate ($114 / 1M) + 2-month onboarding credit (one-time ~10% effective on month1). Net blended ~ $79 — gets us the deal and reserved capacity.
B) Keep list pricing and offer a heavier onboarding credit (reduces near-term margin) but no reserve commit.

My recommendation: Option A gives us predictable committed revenue (reserved lane) and keeps long-term unit economics healthier. Need OK from you both to proceed and sign the MSA with that concession.

If OK, I’ll send updated sheet and a short redline to Legal prepping the MSA with the reserve clause.

Thanks,
Diego

-----Attachment: CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx (same file referenced to Elena)

From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Elena Park <elena@cloudscale.com>
Cc: CloudScale Labs Procurement <procurement@cloudscale.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Final proposal & next steps (MSA + PO)

Elena — looping back with an agreed commercial pathway. We ran the internal ask and can offer the blended cap outcome you requested with the following commercial terms: 

Summary of agreed terms:
- Target blended cap: $80 / 1M tokens at 120M monthly volume (measured as rolling 30-day avg).
- Reserved chat lane: small monthly commit equivalent to 20% of chat volume; reserved chat rate $114 / 1M tokens.
- Embeddings: $50 / 1M tokens.
- Analytics/rerank: $40 / 1M tokens.
- Onboarding: 2-month onboarding credit (applied as a credit equal to 10% of month 1 projected spend).
- Term: 12 months with quarterly cadence to review actual mix and adjust bands.

Attachments: Updated pricing sheet (CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx) and CSL_SOW_draft.docx. I also created a short DocuSign packet for the MSA + SOW — here is the link: https://docusign.com/packet/CSL-4821.

Next steps for your team:
1) Procurement: confirm whether you’ll issue a PO against the SOW or sign the DocuSign packet (either works for us).
2) Engineering: accept the SLOs section in the SOW (we flagged the reserved lane SLOs clearly).
3) Once PO or signed MSA received, we’ll schedule onboarding calls and map traffic cutover.

If procurement wants, I can join a 30-minute call next week to walk the finance people through the blended math. Would Thu 18 Mar 2:00pm PT work?

Thanks again — excited to get CloudScale onto the platform.

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
diego@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: CloudScale_pricing_v3.xlsx, CSL_SOW_draft.docx
